description: Instant all-in price (SGD, GST and Singapore delivery included) and ready-by date for name cards (business cards), printed lanyards, roll-up banners and tote bags in Singapore, for staff, offices or events, including same-day to 5-day rush. Use when someone wants these printed or priced. Pass the deadline to see options that make it. Other custom print and merch goes through request_quote. Example input: {"category":"lanyards","quantity":100}.

category.description: Which event print product to price.

needed_by.description: The date the buyer must have the items in hand, in Singapore time. If given, only options ready by then are offered, with a note when none make it. If left out, every speed option is listed with its ready-by date.

quantity.description: Number of pieces (name cards: number of cards, sold in boxes of 100).

name: quote_event_print
title: Instant quote for event print and merch
